category_title: Young adults with intellectual disabilities who exhibit passive agreement and chronic lateness
minimal_context: Michael and his teacher are in a one-on-one goal-setting session to select a self-monitoring tool and establish expectations for being on time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to select a self-monitoring tool to track your behavior and decide on a goal for your classes. Do you want to use the app on your phone or this paper chart?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will use the paper chart. I am concerned about using my phone during classes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, we will use the paper chart. What do you think would be an appropriate replacement behavior for you to track?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, being on time. What should our goal be for that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to set a goal of being on time for all of my classes.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We need to select a self-monitoring tool to track your behavior and decide on a goal for your classes. Do you want to use the app on your phone or this paper chart?

STUDENT: I will use the paper chart. I am concerned about using my phone during classes.

TUTOR: Okay, we will use the paper chart. What do you think would be an appropriate replacement behavior for you to track?

STUDENT: Being on time.

TUTOR: Alright, being on time. What should our goal be for that?

STUDENT: I want to set a goal of being on time for all of my classes.

task.content: setting expectations for behavior change and selecting a self-monitoring tool

context.materials: paper chart, self-monitoring app on phone, intervention script

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When establishing goals based on baseline data
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: initially wants to set a goal of being on time for all of his classes

behavior_patterns.condition: When selecting a self-monitoring tool for use during the school day
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: chooses the chart as a much more natural self-monitoring tool
behavior_patterns.internal_state: concerned about using his phone during classes

behavior_patterns.condition: When prompted about what would be an appropriate replacement behavior
